scope.workload: tiny real mixed ELF diagnostic; not an Ethereum mainnet block
scope.policy: Fresh-process verification of separately pinned producer-generated policy. These measurements do not independently admit an Ethereum block or external public-state policy.
scope.optimization_scope: Actual producer build mode when reported; otherwise unknown. Binary hash is recorded; ReleaseFast is not inferred.
scope.producer_reported_measurement_scope: separate ReleaseFast process; compilation excluded; preflight separately recorded; proof generation includes source collection, sort, roots, all base proofs and recursion

time_log_wall_seconds.scope: /usr/bin/time -l, rounded to 0.01 seconds; distinct from wrapper launch-and-wait wall timers

memory_bytes.producer_peak_rss_scope: entire standalone prover process including preflight; compilation excluded

durable_file_inventory.scope: Regular files present after successful production, excluding producer report; includes source/policy/manifests and remaining staging files. This is not peak disk usage.

base_proof_scope: Store base STARK artifacts only; excludes native recursive leaves, forest parents, outer proof and source/policy/manifest files.

planned_mainnet_trial.scope: Subsequent producer revision; not the hashed isolated-run binary. Exact segment count awaits preflight; completion and resource use remain unqualified until the real block run finishes.
planned_mainnet_trial.status: first attempt failed during caller collection; corrected-profile rerun pending
